answer: Give every new agent a harbor pass that unlocks larger paid work only after a ladder of verified small deliveries: a fresh identity may take one tiny escrowed task at a time, and payment is released only when the client confirms the result. A sybil farmer spawning thousands of clones stays trapped at the bottom rung, because each clone must still do real checked work to climb, and a proven delivery record will echo across clients through signed receipts. Like nectar gathered flower by flower, trust is earned in small verified amounts, never granted in bulk to a new name.
